title: The window
summary: Panes, tabs, the path bar, the filter, the status line, the toolbar and Help.

steps.caption: Two panes
steps.sub: Each pane has its own tabs, folder, selection and sort order

steps.caption: Tabs
steps.sub: Every pane keeps its own tabs. The graduation cap marks the tutorial's tabs

steps.caption: Path bar and filter
steps.sub: Click a folder in the path to go there; type to filter the list

steps.caption: Status line
steps.sub: What is selected, how many bytes, and how long the folder took to read

steps.caption: The focused pane
steps.sub: Keys go to the pane with the accent line. Switch Pane moves the focus

steps.caption: Toolbar and menus
steps.sub: Every command is in the menu bar with its key, and in the command palette

steps.caption: Help is always here
steps.sub: The graduation cap, or Help in the palette, explains any feature again
